name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Democratic Senate Candidates in Maine Denounce Deadly ICE Shooting
changes.summary: The killing of a man in Biddeford quickly became an issue in the Senate race, with Democrats aiming to tie Senator Susan Collins to President Trump’s immigration crackdown.

changes.title: Morning news brief
changes.summary: Trump says the U.S. will collect tolls and impose blockade in the Strait of Hormuz, man killed by federal agents in Maine, states sue to stop Paramount-Warner Bros merger.

changes.title: Trump's National Guard deployment in D.C. has been extended until 2029
changes.summary: President Trump's deployment of the National Guard to Washington, D.C. has been extended several times. Now, it's set to last until Inauguration Day 2029. (Image credit: Kevin Dietsch).

changes.title: Blanche Was a Driving Force in Retribution Campaign, Emails Show
changes.summary: The cooperation of Todd Blanche in President Trump’s retribution against enemies will be a flashpoint in his confirmation hearing to be attorney general on Wednesday.

changes.title: How a Promising Navy Drone Boat Program Got Mired in Politics
changes.summary: Navy acquisition reforms upended a $2.1 billion contract competition. When it was over, several companies with ties to the Trump administration had made the cut.

changes.title: NATO spending pressure returned
changes.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump holds a press conference at Beştepe Presidential Compound during the NATO Summit in Ankara, Türkiye, on July 8, 2026. —Chris McGrath—Getty Images President Donald Trump announced Monday that he will deliver a “Speech to the Nation” on Thursday evening, though details of exactly what he’ll di.

changes.title: Funding milestone detected
changes.summary: NPR has learned that the Department of Health and Human Services will not be finalizing its most aggressive attempt to end gender-affirming care for youth nationally. (Image credit: Erik McGregor).

changes.title: Trump’s Threat to Impose Fees in the Strait of Hormuz Contradicts His Aides
changes.summary: President Trump said the United States could collect tolls or fees, despite Vice President JD Vance and Secretary of State Marco Rubio saying no country could do so.

changes.title: U.S. strikes Iran for third night after Trump reinstates Iran blockade
changes.summary: President Trump ordered a third consecutive night of U.S. strikes in Iran after reinstating a naval blockade of Iranian ports and proposing new fees for ships transiting the Strait of Hormuz. NBC News’ Garrett Haake reports.

changes.title: Trump reduces the size of 2 national monuments in Utah as Republicans reshape land management
changes.summary: The move to shrink Bears Ears and Grand Staircase-Escalante national monuments unravels protections established by former presidents for areas with unique archaeological and historical features.
